test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K, then how is K related to T?

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Given: ‘W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K'

1) W # Q

means 'W is father of Q.

2) Q @ T

means 'Q is daughter of T.

3) T & Y

means 'T is sister of Y.

4) Y @ M

means 'Y is daughter of M.

5) M % K

means 'M is wife of K.
